headline: Navigare Yachting - Sitio web oficial ®
primaryText: Empresa líder mundial en alquiler y venta de yates. Elija entre uno de nuestros 10 destinos y más de 300 barcos. Sitio web oficial. Flexible.
whyItWorks: It targets people already searching for yacht charter and claims to be the world leader, backed by concrete scale (10 destinations, 300+ boats) that builds trust fast. Calling itself the official site separates it from resellers and comparison sites. Sitelinks for contact, Spain charters and all destinations give several low-friction paths to act, depending on how ready the searcher is.
